8.constraint: Use this camel washed relaxed T-shirt once only for Spring/Summer/Early-Fall Casual Everyday, Weekend, Travel, Campus, a daytime Date or a restrained casual Party. Treat the tee as the outfit's one Fear-of-God/Zara-style relaxed volume and pair it with a clean straight or gently tapered bottom in ecru, stone, light gray, muted olive or controlled washed blue plus a low-profile cream, white, tan or light-gray shoe; never add a baggy, cargo-heavy or puddled bottom, bulky footwear, another oversized layer, a matching muddy-brown palette or any Wedding/Wedding Guest use.

rejectionGroups.reason: These hanger-only, product-only or worn tops are generic dark basics with visible logos, trim or branding and add no clean modern role.
These tanks have deep armholes, long or uncontrolled bodies, muscle-fit presentation, visible branding, dark washed treatment or no credible fit proof and fail the controlled silhouette gate.
The satin ruffle shirt and sequin T-shirt are theatrical costume pieces rather than versatile modern menswear.
These washed zip hoodies are dark, oversized or product-only and repeat a role already covered by a stronger happier-color hoodie.
These shorts are camouflage, distressed, long, wide, print-led or cargo-pocket-heavy and do not meet the clean tailored or controlled casual-short gate.
The black wide-leg trouser pools heavily over the shoes and directly violates the no-puddled-bottom requirement.
These cargo and drawstring trousers are loose, pocket-heavy, cuff-bunched, excessively wide or visibly puddled; even the lighter colors recreate the baggy-bottom problem.
These moto and faux-leather jackets are skinny, shiny, seam-heavy or generic product-only designs with dated low-cost construction.
These bombers and zip jackets are dominated by racing graphics, slogans, patches, contrast panels or novelty prints rather than clean Zara-led outerwear.
The sequin vest and bow-tie presentation is costume/prom styling, not a useful non-wedding modern layer.
The banquet-ready suit is a skinny formal set and is excluded because Wedding and Wedding Guest remain untouched.
The expensive product-only brown/green bomber has visible chest branding, no adult fit proof and an unverified plaid-collar proportion.

qaSummary: 40 identities and all 168 recorded color images rendered; 168 displayed images loaded with zero broken files.
1 accepted with one exact color and variant selected: a camel washed relaxed T-shirt with a modern Fear-of-God/Zara-style proportion.
39 rejected after the base pass and close inspection of 13 variants across four borderline identities; every bottom and outerwear product failed.
The selected identity, source product, variant and image have zero collision with every prior accepted or conditional item.

Rejections include logo and muscle-fit tanks, costume tops, dark oversized hoodies, cargo-heavy or puddled bottoms, faux-leather and racing jackets, a sequin vest, skinny formal tailoring and product-only branded outerwear.
